body:
**Summary**

With the current implementation we register three different listeners for the map (with almost the same logic). The PR update the code to register the same listener on each events. The main changes is that we doesn't check `isRefineOnMapMove` in the `idle` listener anymore. We do it on the other handler. It will avoid to have an outdated `renderState` when refine on map move is disabled.
